name: payoff
description: PAYOFF — self-repaying loans on Robinhood Chain. Borrow USDG on Morpho against tokenized stocks; an agent you scope earns Uniswap V3 fees and pays the loan down, hops to cheaper Morpho markets, and protects you from liquidation.

scripts.compile: cross-env TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.hardhat.json hardhat compile && npm run sync-abis
scripts.test:fork: cross-env TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.hardhat.json FORK=1 hardhat test test/fork/vault.fork.ts
scripts.deploy:contracts: cross-env TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.hardhat.json hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network robinhood
